plan.purpose: Development fit of the published sign-dependent recurrent-feedback hypothesis and two same-data refitted filter comparators. No independent response test or connectome installation.

model.coordinates: Fractional fluorescence relative to gray; positive is hyperpolarization; feedback switches with response sign.
model.boundsRationale: Engineering bounds frozen before recurrent fitting; fast and gap bounds retained from prior comparator, amplitudes retained0..2, w0..40 extends the tested strong-feedback values24/30. These bounds are not physiological intervals.
model.observation: Same flash bins, nominal zero delay, and natural input/normalization as original plan; original flash and natural acquisition limits persist.

developmentData.scope: All targets already inspected in preceding benchmark. CDM and newly acquired T4 responses excluded; no animal-level split.

plan.objective: Each whole trace equal weight: residual=(prediction-measured)/sqrt(number of samples in that trace). Score is mean of trace MSEs. No condition-specific parameter, affine output, delay or response-derived initial state.
plan.selection: Retain every predeclared restart and every invalid proposal. Select minimum meanTraceMSE among converged physically valid attempts, tie earliest restart. Complete only if every restart converges validly with Jacobian diagnostic and selected fitted/startup vectors pass tighter-numerics comparison. A selected verification failure never triggers fallback to another fit. All failures remain visible.
plan.diagnostics: Report all fitted traces individually, zero reference skill and fixed-scale RMSE, all parameter bound hits and range-scaled Jacobian singular values. No pass/qualification from fitting; no causal or concentration interpretation of w/g.
plan.nextEvidence: After complete development fit, freeze any CDM directional consistency plan separately before calculating model changes. A new independent response validation plan remains required.
